english_explanations: to break something into small pieces by pressing it between hard surfaces
to rub together with a harsh noise

chinese_translations.english: to break something into small pieces by pressing it between hard surfaces, or to rub harshly
chinese_translations.example: Milling workers grind dried maize into fine flour for the region's staple breakfast porridge.

english_explanations: a small part representing the whole, taken for testing
a small amount of a product given to try

chinese_translations.english: a small part taken from a larger amount to represent and test the whole
chinese_translations.example: Soil samples collected from the excavation site revealed traces of ancient agricultural irrigation channels.

english_explanations: a short official written message within an organisation
a written record of an agreement or plan

chinese_translations.english: a short official note recording matters or agreements within an organisation
chinese_translations.example: The ministry circulated a memorandum summarising new safety standards for offshore wind installations.

english_explanations: very dirty, polluted or unpleasant
against the rules in a sport

chinese_translations.english: extremely dirty, unpleasant or polluted, or against the rules of a sport
chinese_translations.example: Untreated sewage created foul conditions along the estuary, prompting an urgent public health investigation.

english_explanations: a unit of land measure equal to ten thousand square metres

chinese_translations.english: a metric unit for measuring land area, equal to 10,000 square metres
chinese_translations.example: The reforestation project restored several thousand hectares of degraded hillside within a single decade.

english_explanations: designed to cause fires
likely to cause anger or violence

chinese_translations.meaning: 放火的；燃烧的；煽动性的
chinese_translations.english: designed to start fires, or likely to stir up conflict and anger
chinese_translations.example: Historic city centres suffered devastating incendiary bombardment during the war, requiring decades of careful reconstruction.

english_explanations: the total amount of money a business takes in a period
the rate at which workers leave a company

chinese_translations.meaning: 营业额；人事变动率；成交量
chinese_translations.english: the total income of a business in a period, or the rate at which employees leave and are replaced
chinese_translations.example: High staff turnover in the hospitality sector raises training costs and reduces service quality noticeably.

english_explanations: an enclosed structure in which heat is produced, for heating or melting metals

chinese_translations.english: an enclosed container in which heat is produced for heating buildings or melting metals
chinese_translations.example: Modern blast furnaces recycle waste heat to power nearby industrial plants, cutting overall emissions significantly.

english_explanations: to produce a mass of small bubbles on the surface

chinese_translations.english: to form or produce a mass of small bubbles, as soapy or boiling water does
chinese_translations.example: Polluted river water foamed near the outfall, drawing media attention to lax industrial discharge rules.

english_explanations: a disorder in which part of the body does not develop or is nourished properly

chinese_translations.meaning: 营养障碍；营养不良；萎缩
chinese_translations.english: a disorder in which an organ or tissue wastes away or fails to develop properly
chinese_translations.example: Gene therapy trials have slowed the progression of muscular dystrophy in some young patients, researchers report.

english_explanations: required by a rule or law; something you must do

chinese_translations.english: required by law or a rule and therefore compulsory for everyone concerned
chinese_translations.example: Compulsory schooling up to age sixteen has raised literacy rates across all income groups in the country.

english_explanations: to form small folds or lines in skin or fabric

chinese_translations.english: to form small folds or lines in skin, paper or fabric
chinese_translations.example: Linen garments wrinkle quickly during travel, which is why many business travellers prefer blended fabrics.

english_explanations: the process of decaying and becoming gradually destroyed
a gradually worsening harmful condition

chinese_translations.english: the process of decaying gradually through natural causes
chinese_translations.example: Damp timber supports suffered extensive rot, forcing engineers to close the historic pier for repairs.

english_explanations: a group of similar things growing or gathered closely together

chinese_translations.english: a group of similar things or people positioned very close together
chinese_translations.example: Analysts identified a cluster of childhood asthma cases near the busiest arterial roads of the city.

english_explanations: the chemical process of burning
rapid burning that produces heat and light

chinese_translations.english: the chemical process in which a substance burns rapidly, producing heat and light
chinese_translations.example: Internal combustion engines remain widespread despite rising investment in hydrogen and battery alternatives.

english_explanations: lasting only a short time
using few words

chinese_translations.english: lasting or taking only a short time, or expressed in few words
chinese_translations.example: The minister delivered a brief statement confirming the new environmental targets before answering questions.

english_explanations: to put money or something valuable in a bank or safe place
to leave a layer of material somewhere

chinese_translations.english: to put money or valuables somewhere safe, or to leave a layer of matter on a surface
chinese_translations.example: Rivers deposit fine sediment across the delta, gradually extending fertile farmland toward the open sea.

english_explanations: the size or level of something compared with something else
a set of marks for measuring on an instrument, or the plates covering a fish's skin

chinese_translations.english: the size or extent of something compared to a standard, a system of measuring marks, or the plates covering fish skin
chinese_translations.example: Solar farms now operate at a scale that rivals traditional power stations in total generating capacity.

english_explanations: useful and easy for you, causing no difficulty

chinese_translations.english: useful and easy to use or reach, causing little trouble or effort
chinese_translations.example: The new metro interchange is convenient for commuters transferring between the airport and central districts.

english_explanations: a long flat-bottomed boat used for carrying goods on rivers and canals

chinese_translations.english: a long flat-bottomed boat for carrying heavy goods on canals and rivers
chinese_translations.example: Coal barges once crowded the canal, but today they carry recycled steel to the upstream plants.

english_explanations: a particular kind of material or matter
the most important quality or meaning of something

chinese_translations.english: physical material with a particular composition, or the essential meaning of something
chinese_translations.example: Lab tests identified an unknown chemical substance in the groundwater beneath the abandoned industrial estate.

english_explanations: a solid object with six equal square sides
the number made by multiplying a number by itself twice

chinese_translations.english: a solid with six equal square faces, or the result of multiplying a number by itself twice
chinese_translations.example: Ice pieces cut into perfect cubes melt unevenly in drinks, a detail physicists explain through heat transfer rates.

english_explanations: an unexpected or brief meeting
a battle or confrontation

chinese_translations.english: an unexpected meeting or experience, especially a difficult or hostile one
chinese_translations.example: Researchers describe their first encounter with the uncontacted community as cautious but entirely peaceful.

english_explanations: following what has been done or accepted for a long time
not new or different

chinese_translations.english: based on accepted practice or tradition rather than new methods or ideas
chinese_translations.example: Conventional farming methods still dominate the valley despite growing interest in organic certification schemes.

english_explanations: to improve the appearance of an area of land by planting and shaping it

chinese_translations.english: to improve the appearance of land by planting trees, shrubs and gardens
chinese_translations.example: Architects landscaped the campus courtyards with native species that need minimal irrigation during dry summers.

english_explanations: to give things out to several people or places
to spread something over an area

chinese_translations.english: to share things out among people or places, or to spread something over an area
chinese_translations.example: Relief agencies distribute emergency food supplies to villages isolated by the seasonal flooding each year.

english_explanations: the rate at which goods are produced or work is done

chinese_translations.english: the rate at which a worker, company or country produces goods or services
chinese_translations.example: Flexible working hours improved staff productivity measurably without increasing total overtime payments last year.

english_explanations: to tell the public about a product or service to persuade people to buy it
to make something publicly known

chinese_translations.english: to make a product or service publicly known in order to sell it
chinese_translations.example: Universities advertise postgraduate scholarships widely to attract applicants from lower income families.

english_explanations: to decorate a surface with a raised pattern

chinese_translations.meaning: 压印（凸纹）；使凸出；饰以浮凸图案
chinese_translations.english: to decorate paper, metal or leather with a design raised above the surface
chinese_translations.example: Stationery makers emboss official crests on certificate paper so forgeries are immediately obvious to examiners.

english_explanations: the largest amount or degree possible or allowed

chinese_translations.english: the greatest amount, number or degree that is possible or allowed
chinese_translations.example: The reservoir reached its maximum during the rainy season, allowing engineers to test the new spillway safely.

english_explanations: a person or animal that can produce eggs or offspring

chinese_translations.english: a person or animal of the sex that can bear young or produce eggs
chinese_translations.example: The study compared how male and female students performed on identical spatial reasoning tasks over time.

english_explanations: to treat something as holy or greatly respected

chinese_translations.english: to make holy or to treat with deep respect
chinese_translations.example: Ancient groves were hallowed by local communities long before formal conservation laws protected them legally.

english_explanations: a long supporting pillow
something that gives support or strength

chinese_translations.english: a long firm pillow or cushion, or something that strengthens and supports
chinese_translations.example: Ottoman seating often includes a low bolster that supports the back during long evening conversations.

english_explanations: a thin piece of wood
a stiff device fixed to a broken limb to keep it still

chinese_translations.english: a thin narrow piece of wood, or a stiff support fixed to an injured limb
chinese_translations.example: Nurses fitted a lightweight splint to stabilise the fracture before the ambulance reached the rural clinic.

english_explanations: belonging to a place by birth or origin rather than being brought from elsewhere

chinese_translations.english: belonging to a particular place by birth or origin, rather than introduced later
chinese_translations.example: Planting native grasses along the highway reduced erosion and restored habitat for pollinating insects within two years.

english_explanations: a set of instructions for preparing a dish
a method for achieving something

chinese_translations.english: a set of instructions for cooking a dish, or a method for getting a result
chinese_translations.example: Traditional recipes from the coastal provinces increasingly appear on restaurant menus celebrating regional heritage.

english_explanations: completely necessary and extremely important
a basic necessary thing or idea

chinese_translations.english: a basic thing or idea that is necessary
chinese_translations.example: Clear communication remains an essential of effective teamwork across large and culturally diverse organisations.

chinese_translations.meaning: 本质的；非常重要的；基本的
chinese_translations.english: completely necessary; extremely important for a purpose
chinese_translations.example: Clean water infrastructure is essential to public health outcomes in rapidly growing urban settlements.

english_explanations: the flat surface of a television or computer showing images
a thing that hides or protects

chinese_translations.english: the surface on which pictures are shown on a device, or something that shelters or protects
chinese_translations.example: Ergonomists recommend positioning the screen at arm's length to reduce eye strain during long shifts.

english_explanations: to organise the parts of an activity so they work together well
one of a set of numbers giving a position

chinese_translations.english: to organise different parts of an activity so that they work together effectively
chinese_translations.example: Disaster agencies coordinate relief flights after major earthquakes so that aid reaches the worst hit districts first.

english_explanations: a large heavy book, especially one that is serious or academic

chinese_translations.english: a large heavy scholarly book
chinese_translations.example: The historian's massive tome on maritime trade took nearly two decades of archival research to complete.

english_explanations: covered with sharp points
difficult and complicated to deal with

chinese_translations.english: covered with thorns, or difficult to deal with and causing disagreement
chinese_translations.example: Land reform remains a thorny issue for policymakers balancing historical claims against modern agricultural efficiency.

english_explanations: a small class at a university where students discuss a subject with a teacher

chinese_translations.english: a small university class or meeting for discussing and studying a subject
chinese_translations.example: Weekly seminars give doctoral candidates structured feedback while their dissertation chapters are still taking shape.

english_explanations: a fungus with a round top and short stem, some types edible

chinese_translations.english: a fast-growing fungus, some types of which can be eaten
chinese_translations.example: Shaded forest farms now cultivate gourmet mushrooms that fetch premium prices in urban specialty markets.

english_explanations: a picture or drawing in a book explaining something
an example that makes a point clear

chinese_translations.english: a drawing or picture in a book that explains the text, or a clarifying example
chinese_translations.example: Clear illustrations in the physiology textbook helped students memorise the circulatory system more efficiently.

english_explanations: a statement that you are not satisfied with something
an illness, especially a slight one

chinese_translations.english: a statement expressing dissatisfaction, or an illness or medical problem
chinese_translations.example: The ombudsman resolved hundreds of passenger complaints about delayed rail services within the first quarter.

english_explanations: to join two or more things together to form one
to do two or more activities at the same time

chinese_translations.english: to join things together to form a single effective whole
chinese_translations.example: Modern farms combine satellite data with field observation to time irrigation and fertiliser use precisely.

english_explanations: existing as a natural and permanent part of something

chinese_translations.meaning: 内在的；固有的；生来就有的
chinese_translations.english: existing as a natural, permanent and inseparable quality of something or someone
chinese_translations.example: Researchers caution that sampling error is an inherent limitation of every large scale opinion survey.

english_explanations: to express strong official disapproval of someone's behaviour

chinese_translations.english: to criticise someone severely and formally, especially in public
chinese_translations.example: The ethics committee censured the executive for misreporting emissions data to the environmental regulator.

english_explanations: to save someone or something from danger or harm

chinese_translations.english: to save a person or thing from danger or harm
chinese_translations.example: Volunteer divers rescue stranded swimmers whenever strong currents trap them beyond the harbour breakwater.

english_explanations: increasing quickly and becoming successful

chinese_translations.meaning: 迅速发展的；激增的；繁荣的
chinese_translations.english: growing or increasing quickly and becoming very successful
chinese_translations.example: The booming electric vehicle industry has created thousands of skilled manufacturing jobs in the region.

english_explanations: an animal or human in the very early stage of development before birth
the early stage of an idea or plan

chinese_translations.english: an unborn animal or human in the earliest stage of development, or something in its early stage
chinese_translations.example: Ethics committees strictly regulate experiments involving a human embryo to balance research and moral concerns.

english_explanations: allowing light to pass through so objects behind can be seen
open and easy to understand without secrets

chinese_translations.english: allowing light through so things behind can be seen clearly, or open and honest without secrecy
chinese_translations.example: Transparent budgeting lets citizens track exactly how every municipal project spends its allocated public funds.

english_explanations: to officially ask someone to do a piece of work
to give someone authority for a task

chinese_translations.english: to formally arrange for someone to produce something or do a task
chinese_translations.example: The city commissioned a detailed feasibility study before committing funds to the proposed flood barrier.

english_explanations: a large amount of snow sliding quickly down a mountain
a sudden very large number of things arriving

chinese_translations.english: a mass of snow and ice sliding rapidly down a mountainside, or a sudden overwhelming quantity of things
chinese_translations.example: Avalanche risk rises sharply after heavy snowfall, so authorities close high passes and restrict backcountry skiing.

english_explanations: an object used for fighting or attacking

chinese_translations.english: an object designed to cause harm in fighting, or anything used to gain an advantage
chinese_translations.example: International treaties prohibit developing biological weapons, yet verification of compliance remains technically difficult.

english_explanations: a person who has committed a crime

chinese_translations.english: a person who has committed a crime
chinese_translations.example: Rehabilitation programmes measurably reduce reoffending among young criminals released from regional detention centres.

english_explanations: an object thrown or fired at a target
a rocket that can fly long distances and carry explosives

chinese_translations.english: a flying weapon directed at a target by rockets, or an object thrown at someone
chinese_translations.example: Radar systems track every missile launch within seconds, feeding early warning networks across allied nations.

english_explanations: a line marking the edge of an area of land
the limit of what is acceptable or possible

chinese_translations.english: a real or imagined line marking the edge or limit of an area or activity
chinese_translations.example: The river forms the natural boundary between the two provinces, complicating shared flood management planning.

english_explanations: belonging to the most powerful, skilled or wealthy group in society

chinese_translations.english: belonging to the most skilled, powerful or important group of people
chinese_translations.example: Elite athletes follow individualised training schedules refined through continuous monitoring of physiological markers.

english_explanations: able to resist damage or effect from something
relating to early printed pages checked for errors

chinese_translations.english: able to withstand something damaging, or relating to pages checked before final printing
chinese_translations.example: Waterproof and windproof membranes keep mountain rescue teams dry during prolonged storms at altitude.

english_explanations: based on the idea that everyone should have equal rights and power through voting

chinese_translations.english: based on equal voting rights and fair representation for all members
chinese_translations.example: Democratic institutions function best when courts remain independent from short term political pressure.

english_explanations: spreading quickly among many people in a community
describing a disease that spreads rapidly

chinese_translations.english: describing a disease that spreads rapidly and widely among a population
chinese_translations.example: Epidemic cholera outbreaks declined sharply after municipalities invested in clean drinking water infrastructure.

english_explanations: including every part; whole
total or absolute

chinese_translations.english: including all the necessary parts, or as complete as possible
chinese_translations.example: The archive provides a complete record of shipping movements through the strait during the entire decade.

english_explanations: the way someone stands
an opinion or attitude about a subject

chinese_translations.english: a firmly held opinion or the way a person stands
chinese_translations.example: The university clarified its stance on fossil fuel investments after weeks of sustained student protest.

english_explanations: the power believed to control everything that happens and cannot be changed
what happens to someone or something

chinese_translations.english: the things, especially bad ones, that happen to someone and cannot be avoided
chinese_translations.example: Conservationists fear the fate of the rare leopard rests on protecting a single remaining forest corridor.

english_explanations: a place where roads or railway lines meet
a point where two things join

chinese_translations.meaning: 连接点；交叉路口；汇合处
chinese_translations.english: a place where roads, railways or rivers meet and connect
chinese_translations.example: Traffic engineers redesigned the congested junction so cyclists and pedestrians could cross more safely at peak hours.

english_explanations: the movement of fresh air around a room or building
equipment that provides fresh air

chinese_translations.meaning: 通风；空气流通；通风设备
chinese_translations.english: the movement of fresh air through a space, or the systems that provide it
chinese_translations.example: Improved ventilation in classrooms has been shown to reduce airborne infection rates among schoolchildren significantly.

english_explanations: a place where rubbish is left
a dark unpleasant messy place

chinese_translations.english: a place where unwanted rubbish or materials are left or stored
chinese_translations.example: Converting the old municipal dump into a wetland park improved air quality and property values nearby.

english_explanations: a person who dislikes sudden change and supports traditional values

chinese_translations.english: a person who is cautious about change and supports traditional values or methods
chinese_translations.example: Even political conservatives increasingly support renewable subsidies as clean energy costs fall steadily.

english_explanations: to deal successfully with a difficult problem or situation

chinese_translations.english: to deal with a difficult situation or problem successfully
chinese_translations.example: Coastal cities cope with rising sea levels through a combination of sea walls and restored mangrove buffers.

english_explanations: a gas without colour or smell that burns easily, produced from decaying matter

chinese_translations.english: a colourless flammable gas released by decaying organic matter and livestock farming
chinese_translations.example: Capturing methane from landfill sites turns a potent greenhouse gas into usable fuel for municipal heating.

english_explanations: connected with money, possessions and physical needs rather than the mind or spirit
important enough to affect a decision

chinese_translations.meaning: 物质的；重要的；实质性的
chinese_translations.english: relating to physical needs or possessions, or important enough to affect a decision
chinese_translations.example: Auditors judge whether any discrepancy in the accounts is material before requiring the company to restate earnings.

english_explanations: the main thing being discussed or paid attention to
the point where light rays meet after passing through a lens

chinese_translations.english: the main point of attention, interest or activity
chinese_translations.example: Health policy debate shifted its focus from hospital construction toward preventive community care programmes.

english_explanations: the quality of being easy to understand or see

chinese_translations.english: the quality of being expressed or seen clearly and easily understood
chinese_translations.example: Graphs give financial reports greater clarity, helping non-specialist shareholders interpret quarterly performance quickly.

english_explanations: able to be done or put into practice

chinese_translations.meaning: 可行的；行得通的；可能的
chinese_translations.english: possible and practical to achieve or carry out
chinese_translations.example: Engineers concluded that powering the entire island with offshore wind was technically feasible within five years.

english_explanations: to deliberately pay no attention to something

chinese_translations.english: to refuse to pay attention to something or treat it as unimportant
chinese_translations.example: Firms that ignore early safety warnings often face far higher regulatory costs once accidents occur.

english_explanations: very strange and unusual

chinese_translations.meaning: 怪诞的；奇形怪状的；异乎寻常的
chinese_translations.english: very strange and hard to explain
chinese_translations.example: Deep sea surveys keep revealing bizarre creatures adapted to crushing pressures near hydrothermal vents.

english_explanations: to give a person or group the right to vote

chinese_translations.meaning: 给…公民权（选举权）；使享有政治权利
chinese_translations.english: to give someone the official right to vote in elections
chinese_translations.example: Reformers enfranchised millions of working class voters, permanently reshaping the country's political landscape.

english_explanations: not good or helpful; harmful in effect

chinese_translations.english: having a harmful or negative effect on a situation
chinese_translations.example: Adverse weather conditions delayed the survey vessel, compressing the research team's field schedule considerably.

english_explanations: typical of a person or thing and easy to recognise

chinese_translations.english: very typical of a particular person or thing and easy to recognise
chinese_translations.example: Generous public spaces are characteristic of the city's nineteenth century planning, still evident today.

english_explanations: a light gentle wind
something very easy to do

chinese_translations.english: a light and pleasant wind, or something very easy to do
chinese_translations.example: Afternoon sea breezes moderate the coastal climate, keeping summer temperatures comfortable for tourism.

english_explanations: more than usual or in addition to the usual amount

chinese_translations.english: to a greater degree than usual, or in addition
chinese_translations.example: Inspectors check refrigeration equipment extra carefully during summer months when food safety risks rise sharply.

english_explanations: almost completely or nearly
in a way that relates to real situations rather than ideas

chinese_translations.meaning: 几乎；实际上；从实际出发地
chinese_translations.english: almost entirely, or in a way concerned with real use rather than theory
chinese_translations.example: High speed rail has practically eliminated domestic flights between the two largest cities in recent years.

english_explanations: fair and not favouring any person or side

chinese_translations.meaning: 无偏见的；公正的；不偏不倚的
chinese_translations.english: fair because it treats all sides equally and without personal preference
chinese_translations.example: Unbiased peer review remains the strongest safeguard against exaggerated claims in published medical research.

english_explanations: to dig out earth or ancient remains carefully

chinese_translations.english: to remove earth carefully to uncover buried remains or to make a hole
chinese_translations.example: Archaeologists excavate the settlement layer by layer, recording each find with three dimensional imaging technology.

english_explanations: better in quality than something else
higher in rank or position

chinese_translations.meaning: 更好的；优良的；（级别）更高的；高傲的
chinese_translations.english: better in quality, higher in rank, or behaving as if more important than others
chinese_translations.example: Independent tasting panels consistently rated the regional olive oil superior to imported supermarket brands.

english_explanations: to send out data or power from a device
the amount produced by a person or machine

chinese_translations.english: to send out information or power from a computer or device
chinese_translations.example: Sensors output temperature readings every second, enabling precise control of the greenhouse climate automatically.

english_explanations: a belief that something will happen
a strong hope about how something should be

chinese_translations.english: a belief about what will happen in the future, or a strong hope
chinese_translations.example: Managing customer expectation honestly has proven more profitable than overpromising in marketing campaigns.

english_explanations: to harm someone who trusts you
to show a feeling or secret without intending to

chinese_translations.english: to break someone's trust, or to reveal a secret or true feeling unintentionally
chinese_translations.example: Historians still debate whether the minister intentionally betrayed state secrets to the foreign envoy.

english_explanations: made by people and not occurring naturally
not sincere or real

chinese_translations.english: made by people to copy something natural
chinese_translations.example: Artificial reefs constructed from retired vessels now shelter thriving fish populations off the eroding coastline.

english_explanations: a very large impressive house

chinese_translations.english: a very large expensive house, or a large block of apartments
chinese_translations.example: Guided tours of the Edwardian mansion highlight how industrial wealth shaped the northern city's architecture.

english_explanations: one of several regular payments for something bought over time
one part of a story published or broadcast in stages

chinese_translations.meaning: 分期付款；（连载的）一期；一集
chinese_translations.english: one of a series of regular payments, or one part of a story released in stages
chinese_translations.example: Buying solar panels through monthly installments makes clean energy affordable for low income households.

english_explanations: to suffer or die because there is no food
to not give someone enough food

chinese_translations.english: to suffer severely or die from lack of food, or to deprive something of what it needs
chinese_translations.example: During the blockade, entire districts starved until humanitarian corridors allowed convoys to deliver grain.

english_explanations: the usual weather conditions of an area over a long period
the general situation or attitude at a time

chinese_translations.english: the average weather conditions of a region over years, or the general atmosphere of a situation
chinese_translations.example: Mediterranean climate conditions increasingly support crops once considered suitable only for tropical latitudes.
